# thunder_ddos_zone_template_ssl_l4_ssl_handshake_policy (Resource)

`thunder_ddos_zone_template_ssl_l4_ssl_handshake_policy`: SSL Handshake Policy Configuration

__PLACEHOLDER__



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ssl_l4_tmpl_name` (String) SslL4TmplName

### Optional

- `action` (String) 'drop': Drop packets (Default); 'reset': Reset client connection; 'blacklist-src': Blacklist source IP;
- `cipher_suites_limit` (Number) Set cipher suites limit
- `client_extensions_limit` (Number) Set client extensions limit
- `clienthello_to_appdata_timeout` (Number) Set maximum timeout seconds from ClientHello to App-Data
- `finished_to_appdata_timeout` (Number) Set maximum timeout seconds from Handshake finished to App-Data
- `src_handshaking_conn_limit` (Number) Set handshaking connection limit
- `ssl_handshake_policy_action_list_name` (String) Configure action-list to take
- `uuid` (String) uuid of the object

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
